posts.text: Zettaone’s acquisition by Jubilant Ingrevia looks quite interesting. Jubilant is acquiring a 40% stake for ₹189.2 Cr, implying a valuation of around ₹473 Cr. Zettaone reported revenue of ₹98.1 Cr in FY26, ₹79.1 Cr in FY25 and ₹51.1 Cr in FY24, indicating good growth over the last three years. At nearly 4.8x FY26 revenue, Jubilant appears to be valuing Zettaone not just on current earnings but on its capabilities in electronics design, semiconductor-related engineering and manufacturing.
